method: Batch 85. Same double, row layout and record fields as village-fight-b41-reference.json minus the legacy-mob layout (b37 layout: rows end with the chickens, the jockey flags and the mobs built during the fight), with a plain fake player. Script ops: `t zvillager k` (EntityZombie.setVillager(true)) and `t convert k ticks` (EntityZombie.startConversion, yq.a(int)). EntityZombie.convertToVillager (yq.cd) runs in the zombie update that ends the timer: the villager (mobs kind 2, Entity.rand seeded from the record) is spawned at once and ticks in the same pass, the zombie is set dead and the rest of its update goes on. `loot` is every item or orb entity spawned: [tick, class, x, y, z].
